categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies connection management logic in src/net.cpp and src/net.h to track in-flight manual connections.
categories.rationale: Prevents redundant duplicate manual peer connections caused by race conditions during startup or concurrent RPC calls. As the PR notes, concurrent manual connections can 'attempt the same manual connection concurrently during startup' because 'existing duplicate checks cannot see a peer until it has been added to m_nodes'. While a clean fix for a longstanding issue (#5299), duplicate manual dialing is an edge case with minor operational impact.

categories.rationale: Category covers test framework machinery rather than functional tests pinning domain behavior. Tests pinning specific P2P behavior belong to the p2p category.
